label: Guide me: Clients & years

params.name: lede
params.default: Your firm's client register in {product}: every assessee once, carried into each assessment year - and each year's stage moves by itself.
params.label: lede

default.title: The register
default.say: Every client of your firm, once. Other firms' clients never show here.

default.title: The year at a glance
default.say: How many clients are in this year, how many are audited, and the pipeline by stage.

default.title: Pick the year
default.say: Switch the assessment year; each row shows its form, the 3CD tag and its stage.

default.title: Stages move by themselves
default.say: Nobody picks the stage: statements in, every row mapped, 26AS in and the reds explained, signed off, filed. Each row's dots show where it is.

default.title: A new client
default.say: Name, status, PAN, GSTIN, banks - plus date of birth, non-resident, and the signatory's father's name and PAN for the ITR. The PAN's fourth letter must fit the status.

default.title: Archive, never delete
default.say: Tick the clients you no longer serve - or Select all on this page - and Archive selected. Each moves to the Archived tab with every filing of theirs; nothing is deleted.

default.title: One filing only
default.say: To put away just one year's filing, open the client and press Archive this filing - the client stays active with every other year.

default.title: Bring them back
default.say: On the Archived tab, tick and Restore selected: a client comes back with the filings archived with it; a filing archived on its own comes back by itself.

description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Clients & years walk, up to date with the screen; tours/sf-clients.json is made from it.
